notes.title: Attention Streamlabs Desktop Users
notes.content:
Streamlabs has recently released an update for their version of OBS (Streamlabs Desktop) and it seems to have broken game captures for many users. They have announced that they are aware of the issue and are working on a fix since November 17th, 2023.

What can be done while waiting for them to fix it? 

One user has reported: 
"Open streamlabs and it won't work, and while it's open you open OBS as well, it'll work there. Once it does you just close it and streamlabs should magically work xD"

Otherwise:

1) You can use regular OBS instead
OR
2) you can use window capture instead of game capture. (Window capture requires you to select a background color for stream avatars, and then use that color in the window capture filter option (Color Key). You can adjust it so the background is transparent)

hopefully this video will help users decide if they want to purchase the app or not, also to show transparency on what you will actually be getting.

I personally feel like it needs more features and some better user experience so I will be continuing development after release.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jBs3eNxk_4A&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: What is Stream Avatars?
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29607835/c6fe318c4312a0bbabfc67054e069e342dcad235.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29607835/55e61374192a62aab6ad408f84fc7dee1ee3b1d2.png[/img][/url]

Hey everyone, I've created a video to show some of the features for release,
hopefully this video will help users decide if they want to purchase the app or not, also to show transparency on what you will actually be getting.

I personally feel like it needs more features and some better user experience so I will be continuing development after release.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jBs3eNxk_4A&feature=youtu.be

The video will also be on the steam store page.



The price will be $14.99 USD with 20% off of that for the first two weeks, I feel like this accurately reflects the value of work I put into the software. I do plan on putting features in, so if you are unsure about buying it now because of the lack of features, 
Feel free to wait until I add some features through patches! :summerghost:

Also, thank you to everyone that has shown their interest in Stream Avatars, it is extremely motivating!
